overview: Raydonia is a star system in the Outer Rim Territories, within the Belsmuth Sector, at galactic grid O-6, Documented in the Essential Atlas and StarWars.com galaxy map appendix..
history:
Raydonia appears in galactic surveys spanning the Old Republic, Imperial era, and New Republic periods. Essential Atlas records place the system in Outer Rim Territories.

Trade lanes, sector politics, and regional conflicts shaped Raydonia's role across the nine saga films, live-action series, and expanded lore.
significance: Raydonia is catalogued on the official StarWars.com galaxy map and Essential Atlas appendix as part of the broader Outer Rim Territories chart.
notableEvents: Charted in the Essential Atlas appendix
Listed on the StarWars.com galaxy map
Surveyed as part of Outer Rim Territories sector records
